profile.notes: CB0501 stock MGDB profile. Exact owner replies confirm login, identity, RF/cell channels, traffic, SIM/APN and Wi-Fi inputs. Indexed RF units follow the independently saved manufacturer WebUI. GCF10879 supplies declared model bands, not a fresh live inventory. Explicit operator bands are decided by the router; authentication, current identity, command authority, acknowledgement and matching stored readback remain. Country-qualified serving-operator aliases are explicit profile settings, never a SIM-home or regional default. The optional manufacturer carrier-list route and MGDB band/cell writes remain best-effort related-firmware mappings pending an exact physical CB0501 trial. Missing values stay missing.
profile.authentication_contract: CB0501 operator client: goform login HMAC-MD5; post-login get_login_info; no preliminary status requirement
